title: A function defined in the model is called like a built-in function

source.quote: Once a UDF is defined and saved to the model, you can call it from measures, calculated columns, visual calculations, and other UDFs. This works the same as calling built-in DAX functions.
source.supports: a model function is called by name

derivation: Twice is ( x : NUMERIC ) => x * 2 in the model. 21 is an integer, which NUMERIC accepts as it is: 21 * 2 = 42, an integer.
